blocks.content: Identify unsafe conditions and choose the first safe action (stop, secure, report).

items.definition: An unplanned event that did NOT result in injury or damage but had the POTENTIAL to do so. Near-misses MUST be reported and investigated.
items.analogy: A car that nearly runs a red light without hitting anything — the near-miss reveals a hazard that needs to be corrected before the next attempt isn't so lucky.

blocks.question: A technician slips on a wet floor but catches himself on a bench without falling. How should this event be classified and handled?
choices: It can be ignored — no one was hurt
It is an OSHA recordable incident requiring workers' compensation filing
It is only reportable if the technician required medical attention
It is a near-miss and must be reported and investigated
blocks.feedback: A near-miss is any unplanned event with potential for injury or damage, even if none occurred. Near-misses must be reported and investigated to prevent recurrence.
